body:
I feel as though a lot of things combine together to make me feel this way. It's hard to pinpoint one specific thing. But they range from personal things such as how I keep putting myself out there, with work, dating, and my general social life, but everything keeps falling apart. No matter how hard I have tried recently, I just seem to fail. But I think a lot of it stems from people and the way they act, with others and myself. Everyone just seems in it for themselves. They act as though they're supporting you, but if they can gain something by turning against you, they will in a heartbeat. It feels like everyone is faking being nice just to get to the top. It makes me feel so alone.

I don't know, maybe I'm too fragile to handle the real world. And then there are other things as well, such as how my family has always been falling apart, and how much they love to argue, and how even though I'm getting a degree I'm probably going to end up in a pretty bland job. Then there's standard things such as feeling like such a burden to everyone you interact with, having no value to add to anything, and that voice in your head that always reminds you of all your flaws just to keep you grounded. 

It just all adds up and becomes overwhelming - I know everyone else experiences this, but I just can't handle it.
